subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-10-16
html:
Weekly Pulse — Oct 16, 2026

~15 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Fresh live pull, site_id 12704162.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing on the live site, but this sandbox has no outbound access to the GA4 reporting API, so conversions can't be pulled from here. A scheduled data Action (outside this sandbox) fills this number in later — until then, leading indicators below (rank, backlinks, AI visibility) are the only available signal.

All 22 tracked keywords sat at the not-ranked floor (avg position 100) every single day this period (10/8→10/16), Google USA — unchanged since tracking began 2026-08-01, now 18 straight sessions flat.

Traffic vs last week

No change. SE Ranking's domain overview still returns no ranking keywords for askarlo.app in the US index — no organic footprint to measure traffic from yet, same as every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No. All 52 SEO Report Email runs since kickoff are green, 52/52 all-time, zero failures (confirmed directly via GitHub Actions — Thursday's 2026-10-15 llms.txt fix session, run #52, shipped cleanly). Backlinks flat at 3 / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10 (6th straight week flat). AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured — no AI-visibility baseline exists; this remains a human decision in SE Ranking before AI-citation movement can be tracked at all.

Reading the week

Nothing moved and nothing broke — a quiet pulse. Rank and backlinks are both flat for the same reasons flagged in every recent pulse: both content engines (connector matrix 7/7, comparison hub 5/5) are fully built against current keyword demand, so there's no new code-actionable page to ship, and the levers that would actually move these numbers — GSC sitemap submission, off-page Phase 1 link-building (0/6 registries), and the catalog.ts connectors still past their ETAs — are all human-gated, not something this sandbox can action. Thursday's session (10-15) already caught and fixed this week's one real bug, a dead llms.txt link. No new issue surfaced today.
